topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon Alex’s old journal tucked away in a drawer, and there it was—a bucket list. It's got all these dreams, big and small, and I find myself tracing the lines with my finger, wishing I could make them all come true. It’s like finding a map to a treasure that's already been lost, you know? I mean, we've been through so much, and here are all these precious things Alex wants to do. I just wish I'd known sooner, so I could have been part of it, made some of these moments happen. I’m going to talk to Alex, see if we can make some of these dreams real, one step at a time.
